tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave but provides only five correlated operating points. A high-s_grad probe can distinguish smooth saturation from a possible threshold or branch effect before selecting a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth Haldane, Cobb-Douglas, or hydraulic-basin model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary u_now and s_grad together, so they do not identify their separate effects or rule out a high-gradient threshold.
The immediate ambiguity is behavior in the high-s_grad regime, which the cheaper targeted probe addresses more directly.
It is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity.
